CustomField.description: Lookup (reference) field display override. standard renders the normal lookup input. component replaces it with an inline Form Component rendering the referenced record, driven by referenceFormComponent__c and Alternative_Field__c. startnewform and vieweditsubmission (#391) replace it with the form runtime (c-form-template), and are offered in Form Builder only when the lookup targets Form_Template__c or Form_Submission__c respectively. startnewform passes the HOST record's Id as recordId and the lookup value as fixedTemplateId, so Form_Template_Source__mdt source configuration resolves and falls back to the lookup's template; vieweditsubmission passes the lookup value. Rendering is suppressed when the host record Id equals the lookup value, which would otherwise recurse.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Overrides how a lookup field displays on the form. Form Component renders the referenced record inline through a nested form. Start New Form and View/Edit Form Submission render the full form runtime in place of the lookup, and appear only when the lookup points at a Form Template or a Form Submission.
CustomField.label: referenceFieldOverrideType
